jobs.title: Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

In This Role, You'll:

  • Build high-performance data visualization interfaces and reusable component libraries for complex telemetry data

  • Create intuitive user interfaces for data exploration while optimizing for large real-time datasets

  • Collaborate with backend teams on API design and implementation for seamless user experiences

  • Write clean, maintainable code and participate in technical design discussions

The Skillset You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years of professional experience building web applications and data-driven tools

  • Strong experience building production applications with technologies like React, NextJS, and TypeScript

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimization and browser rendering

  • Experience with modern CSS (Tailwind) and component libraries (Radix UI) for building design systems

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with technical visualization tools (WebGL, D3.js, Apache ECharts) and time-series data

  • Knowledge of WebAssembly and browser-based computation

  • Background in scientific computing or technical data visualization

  • Experience building tools for technical users (dashboards, data-editing environments)

  • Built and launched side projects with consistent usage traffic

Engineering At SIFT:

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

  • Web frontend & backend: React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind, WebAssembly, D3.js, WebGL, and Go 

  • Data: Parquet, Flink, Kafka, Redpanda, Beam, DuckDB, Timescale, QuestDB, InfluxDB, and Druid

  • Infrastructure: GitHub Actions, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform


Location:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to relocating candidates to LA or working from our San Francisco office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $160,000 - $200,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

Eligibility:

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

The Role

As an Account Executive at Sift, you will own complex, technical sales cycles with engineering teams building some of the most advanced systems in the world. You’ll work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, and leadership to identify opportunities, guide customers through technical evaluations, and close deals that deliver measurable engineering impact.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is excited to sell a deeply technical product, engage directly with engineers, and help shape the go-to-market motion at an early-stage, high-growth company.

Responsibilities

Drive New Customer Acquisition

  • Identify and develop new opportunities with engineering-driven organizations across the United States

  • Prospect into target accounts and build relationships with both technical and executive stakeholders

  • Develop account strategies and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities

Run Technical Sales Cycles

  • Lead discovery conversations to understand system architecture, telemetry workflows, and engineering challenges

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product to guide technical evaluations and pilots

  • Define success criteria and drive evaluations toward clear technical and business outcomes

Close High-Value Deals

  • Own opportunities from initial engagement through contract signature

  • Align technical validation with commercial decision-making

  • Navigate procurement, legal, and security processes, including enterprise and government-adjacent environments

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Customer Success

  • Share insights from the field to refine product positioning and sales strategy

Help Build Sift’s US Go-To-Market Motion

  • Contribute to how we sell, who we target, and how we scale

  • Provide feedback on messaging, ICP, and sales process

  • Support hiring and onboarding as the team grows

Maintain Forecast Accuracy

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting

  • Clearly communicate deal progress, risks, and next steps to leadership

What You’ll Gain

  • Experience selling a highly technical product to advanced engineering teams

  • Exposure to complex enterprise and technical sales cycles

  • Opportunity to help shape the go-to-market strategy for a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Close mentorship from experienced enterprise sellers and technical leaders

  • Direct exposure to customers building cutting-edge systems across aerospace, defense, robotics, and industrial technology

We’re Looking For Someone Who

  • Has 6–10+ years of experience in a quota-carrying B2B sales role

  • Has experience selling technical or complex products (e.g., SaaS, developer tools, engineering software, or infrastructure platforms)

  • Is comfortable engaging deeply with technical stakeholders such as engineers, architects, and technical leaders

  • Demonstrates strong curiosity and the ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts

  • Has a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets

  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both technical and executive audiences

  • Thrives in early-stage environments where processes are still evolving

  • Is highly motivated and willing to invest the effort required to succeed in complex enterprise sales

Location

This role is based hybrid-onsite in our LA or SF office 2-4 days per week due to the collaborative and in-person nature of the role. Periodic travel across the US is expected for customer meetings, industry events, and technical evaluations.

Compensation

Base Salary: $125,000-$200,000 USD

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $250,000-$400,000 USD (50/50 base/commission), plus equity, and benefits. Compensation is uncapped and will depend on level, experience, and interview performance.

About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

The Role

As an Account Executive at Sift, you will own complex, technical sales cycles with engineering teams building some of the most advanced systems in the world. You’ll work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, and leadership to identify opportunities, guide customers through technical evaluations, and close deals that deliver measurable engineering impact.

This is a high-impact role for someone who is excited to sell a deeply technical product, engage directly with engineers, and help shape the go-to-market motion at an early-stage, high-growth company.

Responsibilities

Drive New Customer Acquisition

  • Identify and develop new opportunities with engineering-driven organizations across the United States

  • Prospect into target accounts and build relationships with both technical and executive stakeholders

  • Develop account strategies and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities

Run Technical Sales Cycles

  • Lead discovery conversations to understand system architecture, telemetry workflows, and engineering challenges

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product to guide technical evaluations and pilots

  • Define success criteria and drive evaluations toward clear technical and business outcomes

Close High-Value Deals

  • Own opportunities from initial engagement through contract signature

  • Align technical validation with commercial decision-making

  • Navigate procurement, legal, and security processes, including enterprise and government-adjacent environments

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Customer Success

  • Share insights from the field to refine product positioning and sales strategy

Help Build Sift’s US Go-To-Market Motion

  • Contribute to how we sell, who we target, and how we scale

  • Provide feedback on messaging, ICP, and sales process

  • Support hiring and onboarding as the team grows

Maintain Forecast Accuracy

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting

  • Clearly communicate deal progress, risks, and next steps to leadership

What You’ll Gain

  • Experience selling a highly technical product to advanced engineering teams

  • Exposure to complex enterprise and technical sales cycles

  • Opportunity to help shape the go-to-market strategy for a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Close mentorship from experienced enterprise sellers and technical leaders

  • Direct exposure to customers building cutting-edge systems across aerospace, defense, robotics, and industrial technology

We’re Looking For Someone Who

  • Has 6–10+ years of experience in a quota-carrying B2B sales role

  • Has experience selling technical or complex products (e.g., SaaS, developer tools, engineering software, or infrastructure platforms)

  • Is comfortable engaging deeply with technical stakeholders such as engineers, architects, and technical leaders

  • Demonstrates strong curiosity and the ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts

  • Has a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets

  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both technical and executive audiences

  • Thrives in early-stage environments where processes are still evolving

  • Is highly motivated and willing to invest the effort required to succeed in complex enterprise sales

 

Location

This role is based hybrid-onsite in our LA or SF office 2-4 days per week due to the collaborative and in-person nature of the role. Periodic travel across the US is expected for customer meetings, industry events, and technical evaluations.

 

Compensation

Base Salary: $125,000-$200,000 USD

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $250,000-$400,000 USD (50/50 base/commission), plus equity, and benefits. Compensation is uncapped and will depend on level, experience, and interview performance.

  • Design and optimize data pipelines that run entirely in the browser: Web Workers processing Apache Arrow binary data, persistent caching in the Origin Private File System, and multi-layer invalidation strategies that keep the UI responsive while handling datasets that would crash most web apps.

  • Build interactive visualizations for time-series telemetry, FFT frequency analysis, geographic mapping, and scatter plots, and many more, each with distinct performance profiles and correctness constraints.   • Solve performance problems that frameworks can't: bypassing React's render cycle for 60fps interactions, coordinating worker thread pools, managing memory across large binary buffers, and making architectural decisions about what belongs on the main thread vs. off it.

  • Architect composable UI systems for technical users who need full data fidelity. Not simplified dashboards, but tools that expose the real complexity of hardware telemetry with zeptosecond level timestamp precision - Work across the stack boundary. Collaborate with backend engineers on API design, binary serialization formats, and query semantics for structured data endpoints.

The Skillset You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years building software for the web, with meaningful experience pushing browsers beyond their comfort zone, whether that's performance optimization, binary data processing, GPU rendering, multi-threaded architectures, or something else that required understanding the platform deeply

  • Strong TypeScript skills and comfort working in a React codebase, but your value isn't in knowing React APIs. It's in knowing when React is the wrong tool for the job and what to reach for instead

  • Systems-level intuition: you think about memory layout, thread coordination, caching strategies, and data serialization formats, not just component hierarchies

  • Experience building for correctness under constraint. You've worked on software where bugs have real consequences, or you've built systems where data fidelity and performance couldn't be traded off against each other

  • Experience with GPU-accelerated rendering in the browser (WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas 2D optimizations) or technical visualization at scale (D3, ECharts, custom renderers)

  • Hands-on work with binary data formats (Arrow, Parquet, protobuf, FlatBuffers) or columnar data processing

  • Prospect into target accounts and build relationships with both technical and executive stakeholders

  • Develop account strategies and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities

Run Technical Sales Cycles

  • Lead discovery conversations to understand system architecture, telemetry workflows, and engineering challenges

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product to guide technical evaluations and pilots

  • Define success criteria and drive evaluations toward clear technical and business outcomes

Close High-Value Deals

  • Own opportunities from initial engagement through contract signature

  • Align technical validation with commercial decision-making

  • Navigate procurement, legal, and security processes, including enterprise and government-adjacent environments

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Customer Success

  • Share insights from the field to refine product positioning and sales strategy

Help Build Sift’s US Go-To-Market Motion

  • Contribute to how we sell, who we target, and how we scale

  • Provide feedback on messaging, ICP, and sales process

  • Support hiring and onboarding as the team grows

Maintain Forecast Accuracy

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting

  • Clearly communicate deal progress, risks, and next steps to leadership

What You’ll Gain

  • Experience selling a highly technical product to advanced engineering teams

  • Exposure to complex enterprise and technical sales cycles

  • Opportunity to help shape the go-to-market strategy for a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Close mentorship from experienced enterprise sellers and technical leaders

  • Direct exposure to customers building cutting-edge systems across aerospace, defense, robotics, and industrial technology

  • Has 6–10+ years of experience in a quota-carrying B2B sales role

  • Has experience selling technical or complex products (e.g., SaaS, developer tools, engineering software, or infrastructure platforms)

  • Demonstrates strong curiosity and the ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts

  • Has a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets

  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both technical and executive audiences

  • Thrives in early-stage environments where processes are still evolving

  • Is highly motivated and willing to invest the effort required to succeed in complex enterprise sales

 

Location

This role is based hybrid-onsite in our LA or SF office 2-4 days per week due to the collaborative and in-person nature of the role. Periodic travel across the US is expected for customer meetings, industry events, and technical evaluations.

 

Compensation

Base Salary: $125,000-$200,000 USD

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $250,000-$400,000 USD (50/50 base/commission), plus equity, and benefits. Compensation is uncapped and will depend on level, experience, and interview performance.

We turn high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical machines: rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, and defense platforms. Founded by former SpaceX engineers, we are building the review and analysis layer for the AI era of physical systems.

About The Role:

Hardware programs generate far more telemetry than any team can review by hand. Sift Agents is our answer: AI agents that work alongside hardware engineers, investigating anomalies, reviewing test and flight data, and answering in minutes questions that used to take a day of scripting.

This role comes with real product ownership and autonomy. You will talk directly to customers to understand how they review their machines, decide what to build, and own it from first MVP through every iteration after it ships. The surface area is wide: one day you might be polishing the micro-interactions that make the chat experience feel great, the next you might be building a bespoke caching layer for the chat messages off the main JS thread. We’re heavy users of frontier agentic products ourselves and have strong opinions about what makes them great. Sift Agents is where we put those opinions to work.

This is a product engineering role, not a research role. Most of the work is the hard part of making agents feel dependable in the browser: streaming interactions, long-running tasks, rendering agent output over large real-time datasets, and showing engineers exactly what an agent did and why.

In This Role, You'll:

  • Talk directly to customers and partner with product to turn real review workflows into agent capabilities: generating dashboards, writing analysis scripts, and surfacing insights buried in their telemetry

  • Build the frontend surfaces where Sift Agents live, and make them feel great

  • Design the interaction patterns of agentic UX: streaming responses, long-running tasks, interruptions, and showing an agent’s work so engineers can trust it

  • Render an agent’s findings alongside the telemetry that backs them, and keep it fast even when the data is large

  • Push the browser to its limits when the data demands it: Web Workers, OPFS-backed caching, and stepping outside React when the framework becomes the bottleneck

  • Contribute to the component library to keep agentic UI patterns consistent across the product

  • Collaborate with backend and full stack engineers on the API design that powers agent sessions

The Skillset You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Get excited about owning a product area: talking to customers, deciding what to build, and shipping it

  • Have built complex, high-performance web applications with technologies like React, NextJS, TypeScript, or similar

  • Have an eye for detail: you notice the micro-interactions, latency, drops in FPS, and polish that separate good interfaces from exceptional ones

  • Are curious about new AI products: you try new agents, models, and features as they ship, and have opinions about what makes them good

If this role excites you, apply even if you don’t check every box.

Bonus Points:

  • Shipped products to users at scale: large data volumes, significant active user counts, or deep technical complexity

  • Shipped LLM-powered features

  • Built chat or agentic interfaces: streaming responses, tool-call rendering, long-running tasks

  • A strong understanding of web performance optimization and browser rendering

  • Worked with modern CSS (Tailwind) and component libraries (Radix UI) to build design systems

  • Used technical visualization tools (WebGL, D3.js, Apache ECharts), WebAssembly, and time-series data

  • Built tools for technical users (dashboards, data-editing environments)

  • A personal ecosystem of AI dev tooling: custom agents, skills, scripts, or workflows built to ship faster

  • A background in scientific computing or hardware test and telemetry

Engineering At SIFT:

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

  • Web frontend & backend: React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind, WebAssembly, D3.js, WebGL, and Go 

  • Data: Parquet, Flink, Kafka, Redpanda, Beam, DuckDB, Timescale, QuestDB, InfluxDB, and Druid

  • Infrastructure: GitHub Actions, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform


Location:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to relocating candidates to LA or working from our San Francisco office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $160,000 - $200,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

Eligibility:

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

About the Role

Application Software Engineers bridge the gap between Sift’s cutting-edge telemetry platform and our customers’ complex engineering challenges. In this role, you’ll work directly with customer teams to adapt Sift’s capabilities to their needs, build custom solutions, and foster deep partnerships. You’ll collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate customer requirements into actionable insights, ensuring our platform evolves to meet real-world demands.

We’re looking for an engineer who thrives in dynamic, customer-facing environments and is passionate about industries like aerospace, autonomous systems, and renewable energy. This is a rare opportunity to join an early-stage startup and directly impact the success of next-generation machines. You will report to the team's Lead and play a critical role in delivering value to our customers.

In This Role, You’ll

  • Partner with customers to understand their technical challenges and adapt Sift’s platform to meet their specific needs.

  • Develop custom solutions and integrations using Sift APIs to solve customer problems.

  • Translate customer requirements into actionable feedback for product and engineering teams.

  • Create and maintain integrations with common engineering tools to enhance customer workflows.

  • Prepare materials and assist in technical onboarding and training sessions for customer teams.

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with customers, acting as a technical partner and advocate.

The Skillset You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering.

  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with REST APIs.

  • Basic understanding of data analysis and visualization techniques.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Passion for aerospace, autonomous systems, or advanced engineering applications.

  • Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, math, physics, or a STEM discipline.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in any of the following:

    • Aerospace systems, satellite operations, or autonomous vehicle development.

    • Data streaming technologies or time-series databases (e.g., Kafka, InfluxDB).

    • SQL and database concepts.

    • Cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

    • Software integration challenges in complex systems.

    • Machine learning or AI applications in engineering.

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone with a customer-first mindset who’s excited to solve real-world engineering problems in the field.

  • An engineer who thrives in ambiguity and can adapt quickly to evolving customer needs.

  • A collaborative team player who can work effectively with customers, engineers, and go-to-market teams to drive impact.

Location & Travel

  • This role is located in San Francisco, CA. We collaborate in person four times a week—Monday through Thursday—and come together for a full week every quarter at our HQ in LA. We are open to relocating candidates to LA or our San Francisco office.

  • Ability to travel 10-15% required. Varies by location and customer needs.

Sift headquarters is located in Los Angeles (Marina del Rey), and we work in a hybrid environment. We work closely with hardware companies building everything from autonomous vehicles to spacecraft, and it's essential to be nearby for site visits and collaboration.

Salary range: $125,000 - $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.


Eligibility

US Person Required: Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder due to ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) compliance requirements.

  • Identify new, unnamed opportunities: map emerging markets and adjacent verticals outside your assigned accounts, and make the case for where Sift should expand next

  • Travel to industry events and customer sites when it directly supports a named account

  • Use AI-assisted tooling to synthesize account research and draft outreach efficiently

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead our Mission Ops squad. Mission Ops builds the systems and tools our customers use to monitor the health and operations of their machines and fleets, get alerted when a machine enters a critical state, start root-cause analysis and track issues through resolution. You will own technical scope for the squad's user interfaces, APIs and backend systems. Our software must deliver best-in-class performance, scalability and reliability through the most demanding launch campaigns and live operations. Many of our customers run space operations on Sift today, using it to develop and operate rockets, satellites, and orbital laboratory and storage hardware in low Earth orbit and geostationary orbit. In addition to aerospace, we serve other key sectors, such as biomedical tech, energy, transportation and construction.

This role will report directly to the VP of Engineering and is ideal for someone who loves working on the cutting edge of science and technology.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Manage and build a team of high-performing engineers, provide mentorship and guidance to accelerate their growth.

  • Strategy: Collaborate with our Product and Go-To-Market teams to define a technical roadmap shaped by how customers monitor and operate their fleets.

  • Execution: Ensure the team delivers best-in-class results at high velocity while meeting the reliability bar that launch and live operations demand.

  • Process Excellence: Establish and refine engineering processes, agile rituals and use of AI to accelerate development and expand our core capabilities.

  • Hands-on Contribution: Actively engage the architecture and codebase across frontend, APIs and backend services, contribute to high-impact features and help resolve critical technical challenges.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 7+ years in software engineering with 2+ years in a people management role.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related field.

  • Software Development: Strong experience with distributed systems and web applications using Go, Rust, or Python, and with modern frontends built in React and TypeScript.

  • Operations Expertise: Experience building real-time monitoring, alerting, or incident management systems. Familiarity with time-series data and event-driven architectures. Expertise in observability tools such as Grafana or Prometheus.

  • Leadership: Proven ability to guide teams through ambiguity and a track record of being a "force multiplier" for engineering talent.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in Aerospace, Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Defense or Energy.

  • Experience building mission control, ground systems, or fleet operations software.

  • Experience in leading AI-first teams and AI initiatives.

  • Experience designing alerting, anomaly detection, or root-cause analysis workflows for operators.

Engineering At Sift

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

  • Web frontend & backend: ECharts, Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Protobuf, Radix, React, Redux, and TypeScript

  • Data: Arrow, DataFusion, Flink, Parquet, and Rust

  • Infrastructure: Argo CD, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Linux, Prometheus, and Terragrunt

Why Join Sift?

  • Real Impact: Build the infrastructure that enables the next generation of hardware breakthroughs.

  • Amazing Talent: Work alongside veterans from NASA JPL, SpaceX, Palantir, Google, Amazon, Tesla, and the Defense Intelligence Agency.

  • Vibrant Culture: Develop great things with people who all love what they are doing.

  • In-Person Collaboration: Join us in our Marina Del Rey office (2x per week) to stay close to the hardware companies we serve.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Unlimited PTO, equity ownership, 401(k), and full medical/dental/vision coverage.

Location

Sift's headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA. We collaborate in person twice a week, on Mondays and Thursdays, and come together for a full week once every quarter. We're open to relocating candidates to LA for the right candidate.

Salary range: $200,000 - $265,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead our Edge Systems squad. The squad builds Sift Edge, a high-performance server and feature-rich desktop client written from the ground up in Rust. Sift Edge captures full-fidelity data right at the hardware, ingests live sensor streams on a single local machine no matter how remote the site, writes every measurement to disk the moment it arrives, and serves live and historical views in a responsive desktop app. You will expand Sift Edge to support the most rigorous data ingestion and test scenarios in the most extreme environments. Future directions include supporting command and control (C2) capabilities. You will also own development of our open-source client libraries. Customers across aerospace, defense, energy, biomedical tech, transportation and construction rely on this work to test and operate their hardware.

This role will report directly to the VP of Engineering and is ideal for someone who loves working on the cutting edge of science and technology.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Leadership: Manage and build a team of high-performing engineers, provide mentorship and guidance to accelerate their growth.

 - Strategy: Collaborate with our Product and Go-To-Market teams to define the technical roadmap for Sift Edge and our open-source client libraries.

 - Execution: Ensure the team delivers best-in-class results at high velocity while meeting the performance and reliability bar that field testing in extreme environments demands.

 - Process Excellence: Establish and refine engineering processes, agile rituals and use of AI to accelerate development and expand our core capabilities.

 - Hands-on Contribution: Actively engage the architecture and codebase across the Sift Edge server, desktop client and client libraries, contribute to high-impact features and help resolve critical technical challenges.




CANDIDATE PROFILE

 - Experience: 7+ years in software engineering with 2+ years in a people management role.

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related field.

 - Software Development: Strong experience building high-performance, low-latency systems in Rust, with working knowledge of Go or Python.

 - Operations Expertise: Experience with real-time data acquisition, high-throughput ingestion, and durable local storage. Familiarity with cross-platform desktop applications and software deployed on-premises, offline, or in air-gapped environments.

 - Leadership: Proven ability to guide teams through ambiguity and a track record of being a "force multiplier" for engineering talent.




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience in Aerospace, Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Defense or Energy.

 - Experience with hardware test stands, data acquisition systems, or field test operations.

 - Experience maintaining open-source projects or developer-facing client libraries.

 - Experience in leading AI-first teams and AI initiatives.




ENGINEERING AT SIFT

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

 - Web frontend & backend: ECharts, Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Protobuf, Radix, React, Redux, and TypeScript

 - Data: Arrow, DataFusion, Flink, Parquet, and Rust

 - Infrastructure: Argo CD, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Linux, Prometheus, and Terragrunt




WHY JOIN SIFT?

 - Real Impact: Build the infrastructure that enables the next generation of hardware breakthroughs.

 - Amazing Talent: Work alongside veterans from NASA JPL, SpaceX, Palantir, Google, Amazon, Tesla, and the Defense Intelligence Agency.

 - Vibrant Culture: Develop great things with people who all love what they are doing.

 - In-Person Collaboration: Join us in our Marina Del Rey office (2x per week) to stay close to the hardware companies we serve.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Unlimited PTO, equity ownership, 401(k), and full medical/dental/vision coverage.




LOCATION

Sift's headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA. We collaborate in person twice a week, on Mondays and Thursdays, and come together for a full week once every quarter. We're open to relocating candidates to LA for the right candidate.

Salary range: $200,000 - $265,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

About The Role

Sift is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and own the developer infrastructure and testing environments that enable our engineers to ship software faster and with greater confidence.
You'll design systems that allow engineers to spin up complete, production-like environments on demand to test changes, simulate real-world workloads, and validate correctness. As AI coding agents become increasingly integrated into development workflows, you'll build the infrastructure that enables these agents to independently test, debug, and validate the code they produce.

In This Role, You'll:

  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and deployment automation to make testing environments fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.

  • Develop infrastructure that supports diverse testing workloads, including integration testing, correctness validation, load testing, and performance testing.

  • Build tooling for realistic data generation and user behavior simulation to validate software under production-like conditions.

  • Enable AI coding agents to interact with testing environments, execute tests, and validate code changes autonomously.

  • Partner closely with engineering teams to understand developer needs, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve development velocity and software quality.

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in developer infrastructure, test infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer tooling.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, build systems, and deploying applications to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Experience building and automating developer infrastructure, deployment systems, or testing environments, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and reliability.

  • Experience developing or optimizing CI/CD pipelines and automating infrastructure provisioning and deployments.

  • Strong software engineering and programming skills, preferably in Go or Python.

  • Ability to balance infrastructure performance, environment fidelity, reliability, and cost.

  • Strong collaboration skills and a developer-focused mindset, with experience building tools that improve engineering productivity.

  • Experience building ephemeral or on-demand development and testing environments.

  • Load testing, performance testing, or distributed test execution.

  • Browser automation and end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright or Cypress.

  • Building sandboxed execution environments or infrastructure supporting AI coding agents.

  • Working on developer infrastructure at a fast-scaling technology company, cloud platform, or compute provider.

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

  • Web frontend & backend: ECharts, Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Protobuf, Radix, React, Redux, and TypeScript

  • Data: Arrow, DataFusion, Flink, Parquet, and Rust

  • Infrastructure: Argo CD, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Linux, Prometheus, and Terragrunt

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to relocating candidates to LA or working from our San Francisco office for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own core user experiences across Sift's platform. You'll design complex, data-rich interfaces that help engineers monitor, analyze, and make decisions about mission-critical hardware systems.

This is a hands-on role spanning user research, interaction design, prototyping, and polished UI execution. You'll work closely with Product Management and Engineering from problem definition through launch, using our design system while helping evolve it.

We're looking for someone who combines strong design craft with systems thinking, enjoys working directly with technical users, and is excited to use AI-assisted tools to explore, build, and iterate faster.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end design process for core product experiences, from problem discovery and user research through prototyping, validation, and launch.

  • Conduct user research, including on-site customer visits, to understand how engineers work with complex telemetry data and translate their needs into intuitive workflows.

  • Design sophisticated, data-dense interfaces with a high bar for usability, interaction quality, and visual craft.

  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and ship improvements based on user feedback and product outcomes.

  • Use AI-assisted design and development tools, such as Claude Code and Figma MCP, to build interactive prototypes, explore solutions, and accelerate iteration.

  • Contribute reusable components, interaction patterns, and improvements to Sift's design system.

  • Participate in design critiques, share new tools and workflows, and help raise the quality of design across the team.

Required Skills:

  • 6+ years of experience in product design (UI/UX), with a strong portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex software experiences.

  • Strong interaction design skills, particularly for technical, data-rich, or workflow-heavy applications.

  • Ability to work across the full design process, from user research and information architecture to detailed interaction design and polished visual interfaces.

  • Experience building interactive prototypes to communicate, test, and refine design solutions.

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex workflows while maintaining consistency across a product.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, incorporate feedback, and build alignment across teams.

  • Interest in using AI-assisted tools to improve design workflows, with a willingness to experiment and adopt new approaches.

  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and move quickly without sacrificing design quality.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience designing data visualization, observability, monitoring, analytics, or other data-intensive products.

  • Familiarity with charts, dashboards, real-time data displays, or complex technical workflows.

  • Experience designing tools for engineers, developers, scientists, or other highly technical users.

  • Background in aerospace, defense, robotics, industrial systems, or advanced hardware.

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Figma MCP, or other AI-assisted prototyping and development tools.

  • Experience working at an early-stage startup and contributing to a growing design system.

Portfolio Required: Please include a link to your portfolio or relevant design work. Applications without visual work samples will not be considered.

Location:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week in our Los Angeles or San Francisco office—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week in LA once every quarter. We are open to relocating candidates to work from either office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $160,000 - $230,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

Eligibility:

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

ABOUT SIFT

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. We turn high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical machines: rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, and defense platforms. Founded by former SpaceX engineers, we are building the review and analysis layer for the AI era of physical systems.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Sift is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and own the developer infrastructure and testing environments that enable our engineers to ship software faster and with greater confidence.
You'll design systems that allow engineers to spin up complete, production-like environments on demand to test changes, simulate real-world workloads, and validate correctness. As AI coding agents become increasingly integrated into development workflows, you'll build the infrastructure that enables these agents to independently test, debug, and validate the code they produce.
Sift processes high-volume telemetry from complex hardware systems, making realistic testing environments particularly challenging. This is a foundational, high-ownership opportunity to architect and scale the infrastructure that powers how we develop, test, and ship software.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:

 - Design and build infrastructure that provisions isolated, production-like testing environments on demand, enabling engineers to validate changes against Sift's full application stack.

 - Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and deployment automation to make testing environments fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.

 - Develop infrastructure that supports diverse testing workloads, including integration testing, correctness validation, load testing, and performance testing.

 - Build tooling for realistic data generation and user behavior simulation to validate software under production-like conditions.

 - Enable AI coding agents to interact with testing environments, execute tests, and validate code changes autonomously.

 - Partner closely with engineering teams to understand developer needs, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve development velocity and software quality.
   


THE SKILLSET YOU'LL BRING:

 - 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in developer infrastructure, test infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer tooling.

 - Deep hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, build systems, and deploying applications to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Experience building and automating developer infrastructure, deployment systems, or testing environments, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and reliability.

 - Experience developing or optimizing CI/CD pipelines and automating infrastructure provisioning and deployments.

 - Strong software engineering and programming skills, preferably in Go or Python.

 - Ability to balance infrastructure performance, environment fidelity, reliability, and cost.

 - Strong collaboration skills and a developer-focused mindset, with experience building tools that improve engineering productivity.


BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience building ephemeral or on-demand development and testing environments.

 - Load testing, performance testing, or distributed test execution.

 - Browser automation and end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright or Cypress.

 - Building sandboxed execution environments or infrastructure supporting AI coding agents.

 - Working on developer infrastructure at a fast-scaling technology company, cloud platform, or compute provider.


ENGINEERING AT SIFT:

You'll have the opportunity to  help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

 - Web frontend & backend: ECharts, Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Protobuf, Radix, React, Redux, and TypeScript

 - Data: Arrow, DataFusion, Flink, Parquet, and Rust

 - Infrastructure:  Argo CD, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Linux, Prometheus, and Terragrunt


LOCATION:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to relocating candidates to LA or working from our San Francisco office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $180,000 - $230,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.
